images.title: Tip above for a dipping arc
images.purpose: Show that an arc dipping in the middle is drawn with the compass tip above the figure.
images.composition: A simple scarecrow body rectangle in the lower area, a compass tip dot above it, wide margins.
images.exact_structure: One upright rectangle body in teal #0072B2, with its top edge an arc that dips downward in the middle, passing through both top corners. One amber #E69F00 dot above the body, in line with its middle, marking the compass tip. Two grey #6B7280 straight lines from that dot to the two top corners. Exactly 1 body, 1 dot, 2 lines.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
the tip dot inside the body
images.takeaway: A dipping arc is drawn from a tip above the figure.
images.description: A teal rectangle body whose top edge dips in the middle, with an amber compass tip dot above it joined by two grey lines to the top corners.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at where the compass tip sits and which way the arc bends.

image_decisions.why: One body with the tip above it carries the idea.
